packageRules.description: One PR for all non-major updates. A solo maintainer reviewing eight separate patch bumps is eight chances to rubber-stamp one.
TypeScript is pinned with ~ because typescript-eslint declares a peer range it must stay inside. A major bump here silently disables linting, so it needs a human.
Node major bumps touch the Dockerfile, CI and engines together.
